mapper.insert: insert into user_contribution(user_id, question, answer, category_id, supplement, contact, status, created_time) values (#{userId}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{categoryId}, #{supplement}, #{contact}, #{status}, #{createdTime})
mapper.select:
select uc.id, question, answer, c.name as categoryName, CASE uc.status WHEN 0 THEN '待审核' WHEN 1 THEN '已通过' WHEN 2 THEN '已驳回' END as statusDesc, uc.created_time, uc.reviewed_time, uc.reject_reason from user_contribution uc left join category c on uc.category_id = c.id
and uc.user_id = #{userId}
and uc.status = #{query.status}
and question like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%')
order by uc.created_time
desc
asc
